=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:330-360 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `lease_wait` branches in review_enable_auto_merge.sh (lines 330-331, 359-360) do not check `MERGE_LEASE_REASON=source_issue_not_planned`. The same branches in scripts/review_rb_judge.sh (2743-2746, 2762-2763, 2858-2859, 2877-2878, 3432-3435) and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (30483-30491) have the same gap. The last run added the orphan-specific message only inside `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2283-2288). For an orphan, `MERGE_LEASE_BLOCKER` is empty (reset at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4491, and the skip returns at :4574/:4401 before the assignment at :4591), so these sites print "held by or queued for PR #?" and promise a re-dispatch "when the lease is granted".
  WHY: The merge-train tick skips orphan PRs on purpose and permanently (for example #9562 on `ai/issue-9519`), so operators see a blocker that names no PR and a re-dispatch that never happens. minimax adds that review_rb_judge.sh:2745 sets `RB_MERGE_STATUS="mergeability_pending"`, so later review sweeps loop on the orphan. Severity is disputed: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and minimax_minimax-m3 rated it MAJOR; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT as message-only, because the deferral itself is correct. The highest rating is used.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:`_merge_lease_gate_source_issue_skip` (LAST RUN DIFF hunk; :4556, :4572-4574) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: minimax reviewed the orphan-skip helper and its callers in the single-holder branch: the orphan exclusion passed to `_merge_lease_queue_first`, and `_merge_lease_label_wait` called only on the "held" branch. It found them correct, and says the only remaining gap is the caller-side messages.
  WHY: The runtime behaviour of scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh is correct on the orphan path. The failure shows up only in the sibling scripts' `lease_wait` branches.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2283-2288 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: No test in tests/test_merge_lease.py or tests/test_pr_base_freshness_gate.py checks that the new `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` orphan message is printed and that the generic "held by or queued for PR #?" / "re-dispatched when the lease is granted" text is suppressed.
  WHY: A change to the user-facing message could regress silently. The new test `test_multi_holder_join_still_passes_over_labelled_live_holders` covers only the `_merge_lease_gate_multi` join path. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point only as hardening suggestions.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "the merge-lease tick (single- and multi-holder) never grants a labelled waiter whose same-repository head is `ai/issue-<n>` when issue `<n>` is closed with state reason `not_planned`, ... the update-mode lease gate (a pull request's own review or update run) applies the same check when the lease is free or it would join as a holder" (issue #10121 G4), plus the "owner decides" messaging
  expected_change_site: every shell caller of `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` / `_merge_lease_gate` that prints a `lease_wait` message: scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh (lines 330-331, 359-360), scripts/review_rb_judge.sh (lines 2743-2744, 2762-2763, 2858-2859, 2877-2878, 3432-3435), scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (lines 30483-30490)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The orphan-specific branch exists only in `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2283-2288). The sibling sites still print "PR #${MERGE_LEASE_BLOCKER:-?}" and "re-dispatched when the lease is granted to it" without checking `MERGE_LEASE_REASON=source_issue_not_planned`. `MERGE_LEASE_BLOCKER` is empty on the orphan-skip path (reset at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4491).
- requirement: "When [the own-PR] read failed, [the reissue] also refuses"; the planned operations include a verdict recorded as a wait
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, the own-PR refusal branch around lines 2789-2817
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: For an unknown result with no PR number, the branch posts or suppresses a comment and returns. It does not set verdict_name to wait or write an ai:unblock-wait marker, and the wait-handling path starts later at line 2821.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:lines 330-331 and 359-360 (also scripts/review_rb_judge.sh lines 2744, 2763, 2859, 2878 and 3435) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `lease_wait` branches print "waiting for the merge lease held by or queued for PR #${MERGE_LEASE_BLOCKER:-?} ... The merge-train release re-dispatches this PR when the lease is granted to it." The orphan message (`MERGE_LEASE_REASON=source_issue_not_planned`) was added only in `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh lines 2283-2288). `_merge_lease_gate_source_issue_skip` returns 1 without setting `MERGE_LEASE_BLOCKER`.
  WHY: For an orphan such as #9562 on `ai/issue-9519`, the log says "PR #?" and promises a re-dispatch that never happens, because the tick skips orphans (`outcome=skipped reason=source_issue_not_planned` in scripts/review_merge_train.sh). This affects messages only; the deferral is correct. Fix: check `MERGE_LEASE_REASON` at each site (about 3 lines per site).
- HARDENING (risk score 1): tests/test_merge_lease.py, in `test_update_gate_never_gives_an_orphan_a_free_lease` or the freshness-gate tests: assert the orphan message from scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh lines 2283-2285 ("its source issue was closed as not planned", and no "is re-dispatched when the lease is granted"). About 3 lines.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh lines 330-331 and 359-360: add a `[ "${MERGE_LEASE_REASON:-}" = "source_issue_not_planned" ]` orphan-specific echo. About 6 lines.
- Verification notes: the `_merge_lease_gate_multi` `gm_excluded` append fix (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh lines 4402-4403) is correct. The new test's helpers exist. The `own_pull_requests` judge-prompt wording was deferred (prompts/ is outside files_touched) and was not counted.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:331, :360; scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2744, :2763, :2859, :2878; scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:30490 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: These scripts handle `lease_wait` outcomes without accounting for `MERGE_LEASE_REASON=source_issue_not_planned`, and print generic messages keyed on `MERGE_LEASE_BLOCKER`.
  WHY: Operators see "held by or queued for PR #?" for an orphan and are wrongly promised a re-dispatch "when the lease is granted"; in fact the PR is skipped permanently and the owner must step in by hand.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:lines 330-331 and 359-360; scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2743-2744, 2762-2763, 2858-2859, 2877-2878, 3432-3435; scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:30483-30490 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The orphan message was added only in `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2283-2288). `MERGE_LEASE_BLOCKER` is reset to "" at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4491 and is never assigned on the orphan-skip path (the assignments are at :4527, :4376, :4388, :4418, :4440, :4591). The six other sites therefore print "PR #?" and promise a re-dispatch.
  WHY: The message names a PR that does not exist and a retry that never comes (affected orphans include #9562 on `ai/issue-9519` and #9899 on `ai/issue-9887`). Also, review_rb_judge.sh:2745 sets `RB_MERGE_STATUS="mergeability_pending"`, so later sweeps loop on the orphan.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:LAST RUN DIFF hunk, `_merge_lease_gate_source_issue_skip` and its callers | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Reviewed the orphan exclusion passed to `_merge_lease_queue_first` (:4572), `_merge_lease_label_wait` (called only on the held branch, :4556) and the single-holder return (:4574). All are correct; the only gap left is the caller-side messages.
  WHY: The runtime behaviour of pr_checks_lib.sh is correct; the failure shows up only in the sibling scripts' `lease_wait` branches.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:lines 2283-2288 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: No test in tests/test_merge_lease.py or tests/test_pr_base_freshness_gate.py checks that the orphan message is printed and the generic text is suppressed. `test_multi_holder_join_still_passes_over_labelled_live_holders` covers only the join path.
  WHY: A user-facing message could regress silently.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: issue #10121 G4 (the tick and the update-mode lease gate skip `not_planned` orphans) and the "owner decides" messaging.
  Expected change site: scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh (330-331, 359-360), scripts/review_rb_judge.sh (2743-2744, 2762-2763, 2858-2859, 2877-2878, 3432-3435), scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (30483-30490).
  Evidence of absence: the orphan branch exists only in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2283-2288, and the sibling sites still print "PR #${MERGE_LEASE_BLOCKER:-?}" and the re-dispatch promise.
- HARDENING (risk score 1; 3 related items): add an orphan-reason gate and an orphan-specific sentence at review_enable_auto_merge.sh (about 8 lines), review_rb_judge.sh (4-6 lines per site, and clear `RB_MERGE_STATUS` instead of `mergeability_pending`), and orchestrate_poll_process.sh (about 4 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
